title: Air Horn
blurb: The air horn — official sound of hype since the DJ era, honking over every drop, goal, and questionable achievement. Its roots are genuinely nautical: reggae and dancehall sound systems borrowed the ship's horn as a crowd signal, and dance music inherited it from there. This is a clean synthesised blast with the brassy stacked-harmonic character of the real thing, minus anyone else's recording. Spam it responsibly or don't — stream wins, celebrations, and moments that absolutely did not deserve an air horn but are getting one anyway.
origin: Original harmonic-stack synthesis in the style of the classic DJ air horn.
